item.text: The Perth Casino Royal Commission examined whether the casino licensee and associated Crown companies were suitable to conduct casino gaming, and whether Western Australia’s regulation was adequate.
item.support:
The second area was the adequacy of the framework to regulate casinos in 
Western Australia.

item.text: The Commission found that the licensee was unsuitable to retain its licence and that the associated companies were unsuitable to organise or conduct casino gaming.

item.quote:
Burswood Nominees Ltd is not a ‘suitable person’ to continue to hold the gaming licence for 
Perth Casino.

We have concluded that the legislation by which Perth Casino 
is regulated is not fit for purpose and requires replacement with a modern regulatory framework.

Consequently, some of Perth 
Casino’s patrons have suffered considerable and avoidable harms as a result of their gambling.
